currentStateEvidence:
Greenfield component per Solution Blueprint. Target responsibilities:
• Persist the application's data in a single local database file on the user's machine.
• Protect the data at rest as the confirmed data decision requires (for example encryption, with the key kept in the operating-system key store).
• Support backup and restore of the one file, and versioned local schema upgrades when the application is updated.
changeContract: Accessed only through the domain modules, in-process, through the embedded database driver; no network access.

contractChanges.changeDescription: Accessed only through the domain modules, in-process, through the embedded database driver; no network access.
Embedded relational schema with versioned local upgrades; the file is created on first run and never leaves the user's machine unless the user exports it.

qualityAndSecurity: Input validation at every file, clipboard and import boundary; encrypt data at rest as the data decision requires; no network trust boundary exists.
No secret or key hard-coded or stored beside the data — keep encryption keys in the operating-system key store (or derive them from user input), never in source, the database file or logs.
Clean architecture boundaries: adhere to separation of concerns and dependency inversion.
Data handling and retention specification: Embedded relational schema with versioned local upgrades; the file is created on first run and never leaves the user's machine unless the user exports it.
API contract and security requirements: Accessed only through the domain modules, in-process, through the embedded database driver; no network access.
Architecture decomposition boundary: Centralized relational database ensures ACID transaction guarantees and cross-module relational consistency without complex distributed transactions.
